thread:
ben-finance: Heads-up: Invoice from CH-TAx Solutions for Redwood EU SRL. They applied 10% withholding and included a note asking for gross-up. Invoice missing VAT ID for their Swiss branch.

anya-legal: Who's the billed entity (Lux vs NL vs US)? treaty determines relief.

ben-finance: Billed to Redwood EU SRL (Lux). SOW = platform integration support.

maria-vendor: Hi Ben, Maria here. We added 10% WHT per our advisor. Can provide CFR and reissue with gross-up if Redwood prefers.

tax-bot: Reminder: For Swiss suppliers billing Luxembourg, we need Certificate of Fiscal Residence to consider DTA relief. W-8/W-9 not applicable.

anya-legal: Please ask for CFR and clear invoice lines: gross amount, WHT amount, net due, vendor tax reg number and bank details. Document needed to claim treaty relief or refund.

ben-finance: Sent request to vendor for CFR + updated invoice. Holding payment until docs are in.

maria-vendor: CFR attached to email, invoice v2 attached: "Fees 18,000 EUR - WHT 1,800 EUR (10%) - Net 16,200 EUR". Also added note: "Vendor prefers gross-up if possible".

anya-legal: I'll review DTA article tonight. If services fall under business profits and no PE in LU, treaty may zero-rate WHT. Might need Luxembourg tax authority clearance to apply reduced rate at source.

ben-finance: Ok. If we can apply reduced rate at source we will. Otherwise we withhold and provide vendor with documentation to claim a refund/credit.

tax-bot: Checklist updated: [CFR received, updated invoice, vendor tax reg number, legal DTA review].
